players.product: EcoStruxure UPS, PDU, prefab modular datacenter blocks

quarterly_data.signal: Schneider Electric introduced a new range of standardized Prefabricated Power Modules and Power Skids for hyperscale, neocloud and colocation data centers, powered by its Galaxy VXL (GVXL) UPS technology. Available in 2MW, 2.25MW and 2.5MW configurations, with up to 2.5MW per module - which the company calls the largest single-container prefabricated power solution it has brought to market. They are based on Schneider Electric's latest reference designs with NVIDIA (integrated power management and liquid cooling controls for the GB300 NVL72 platform), and the company says they let customers deploy AI-ready power infrastructure in as little as six months. Available immediately in Europe; North America later this year, followed by additional international markets and APAC. The modules are engineered, manufactured and tested at Schneider Electric's Sant Boi de Llobregat (Barcelona) site, which the company says was recently expanded to support growing global demand for modular data center infrastructure. No customers or prices stated.
quarterly_data.figure: 2MW, 2.25MW and 2.5MW configurations; up to 2.5MW per module; deployment in as little as six months; available immediately in Europe, North America later this year
